results.name: Nozomi Networks, il cofondatore Andrea Carcano torna alla guida come CEO
results.content:
Andrea Carcano torna CEO di Nozomi Networks. Dopo l’acquisizione di Mitsubishi Electric, la nuova fase punta sull’AI e sulla sicurezza OT
Il cambio al vertice arriva pochi mesi dopo il completamento dell’acquisizione di Nozomi Networks da parte di Mitsubishi Electric. L’operazione, conclusa nel gennaio 2026, ha trasformato la società di cybersecurity in una controllata interamente posseduta dal gruppo giapponese.
Carcano subentra a Edgard Capdevielle, che ha guidato Nozomi Networks negli ultimi dieci anni e continuerà a collaborare con l’azienda nel ruolo di executive advisor. Il passaggio di consegne apre una fase incentrata sull’accelerazione dello sviluppo tecnologico e sull’impiego dell’intelligenza artificiale nella protezione delle infrastrutture industriali. Al fianco del nuovo CEO resterà Moreno Carullo, cofondatore e Chief Technology Officer.
Capdevielle ha descritto gli anni trascorsi alla guida di Nozomi Networks come una fase particolarmente importante della propria carriera. Nel nuovo ruolo di advisor continuerà a sostenere il gruppo, dedicandosi parallelamente ad aiutare altre imprese nelle prime fasi del loro sviluppo. Con il ritorno di Carcano nel ruolo di CEO, Nozomi Networks avvia così un nuovo capitolo affidandosi nuovamente ai propri fondatori.
La nuova fase sarà caratterizzata soprattutto dall’intelligenza artificiale. Nozomi Networks ritiene che la leadership nella sicurezza OT, IoT e dei sistemi cyber-fisici dipenderà sempre più dalla capacità di sviluppare e utilizzare tecnologie AI.

results.name: Nozomi Networks appoints co-founder Carcano as CEO
results.content:
# Nozomi Networks appoints co-founder Carcano as CEO  
Wed, 29th Jul 2026  
[JOSEPH GABRIEL LAGONSIN News Editor](https://telconews.com.au/author/joseph-gabriel-lagonsin)  
Nozomi Networks has appointed co-founder Andrea Carcano as Chief Executive Officer, returning him to the role after a decade under Edgard Capdevielle's leadership.  
Capdevielle will become Executive Advisor after overseeing the cybersecurity company's growth to more than AUD $143 million in revenue and its AUD $1.4 billion acquisition by Mitsubishi Electric.  
Carcano served as Nozomi's original Chief Executive Officer when he and co-founder Moreno Carullo launched the business. The leadership change returns the operational technology, Internet of Things and cyber-physical systems security company to founder-led management.  
The move follows Mitsubishi Electric's acquisition of Nozomi, which was presented as preserving the company's independent operations and vendor-neutral approach. Customer-facing functions, including account teams, support commitments, partner programmes and the product roadmap, will remain unchanged.  
During Capdevielle's tenure, Nozomi expanded its reach among major industrial groups. Its customer base includes five of the 10 largest oil and gas companies, seven of the 10 largest pharmaceutical manufacturers and seven of the 10 largest utilities.
Nozomi also highlighted industry recognition from Gartner and Forrester during that period, alongside sustained cash-flow break-even performance after surpassing USD $100 million in annual revenue. It said that made it the first privately held operational technology cybersecurity company to reach that level.  
In a statement on the transition, Carcano thanked his predecessor and linked the change to the company's origins.  
"Edgard has been an extraordinary partner to Moreno and me for the past decade - on behalf of everyone at Nozomi, thank you, Edgard. Stepping into this role feels like returning to where our story began, only now with the conviction of everything we've proven since: category-defining products, the trust of the world's most critical operators, and market leadership recognised across the industry. Moreno and I built Nozomi side by side from the very first lines of code, and side by side is exactly how we'll lead its next chapter. This is a new Day 1 - the same hunger and audacity that started this company, now with everything it takes to win at the largest scale," said Andrea Carcano, Co-Founder and Chief Executive Officer, Nozomi Networks.  
**Founder return**  
Nozomi framed the appointment as the start of a new phase under its founders. Carullo, who remains Chief Technology Officer, said artificial intelligence would shape competition across the sector.
"Leading Nozomi through this stage of its journey has been the honour of my career. Andrea and Moreno built something extraordinary, and I'm proud of what we accomplished together. I'm looking forward to continuing to support the team as an advisor while returning to what I love most - helping early-stage companies find their way. Nozomi's best chapter is the one that starts today," said Edgard Capdevielle, Executive Advisor, Nozomi Networks.

Its platform combines network and endpoint visibility, threat detection, and AI-driven analytics to help industrial organizations improve threat detection, incident response, and operational resilience across complex industrial environments. © Copyright 2012 - 2026 | citybiz | Terms of Service | All Rights Reserved
Nozomi Networks has appointed co-founder Andrea Carcano as chief executive officer, returning him to the role he held when the industrial cybersecurity company was founded and marking a leadership transition focused on accelerating AI-driven innovation following its acquisition by Mitsubishi Electric.
The company’s acquisition by Mitsubishi Electric provides additional financial resources and industrial market access while allowing Nozomi to continue operating independently and maintain its vendor-neutral approach, the company said.
Carcano succeeds Edgard Capdevielle, who led the company for the past decade and will remain with Nozomi as an executive advisor.

results.name: Nozomi Networks
results.content:
# Nozomi Networks  
Nozomi Networks is a leader in OT cybersecurity technology, providing industrial cybersecurity solutions that deliver unmatched asset intelligence, threat detection, and AI-driven insights.
### 2d
Edgard Capdevielle, Chief Executive Officer at Nozomi Networks, stands as a distinguished leader in cybersecurity, corporate strategy, and private equity investments. With nearly a decade at the helm of Nozomi Networks, he has transformed the company into the definitive leader in OT and IoT security, culminating in a ~$1 billion acquisition. His expertise spans product management, marketing, business development, and strategic execution, backed by an MBA from UC Berkeley's Haas School of Business. A board director at Alethea and an active investor in multiple successful startups including Veza (acquired by ServiceNow), Datos IO (acquired by Rubrik), Caspida (acquired by Splunk), Authy (acquired by Twilio), and Xoom (acquired by PayPal), Mr. Capdevielle exemplifies the rare combination of visionary CEO and disciplined operator.
### 13h
In a world of constant threats, execution matters.
Congratulations to the Global Infosec Award Winner 2026, Nozomi Networks, setting the pace for what modern security should look like.
